name: Charlotte Shiften
source:
While a tourist trap for many, for the Shiftens the aquarium is a home away from home.

Charlie's been a tour guide for over 20 years, raising her daughter alongside the sealife.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/vnstudioelan/status/1663593777049501714]Twitter[/url]]
